intro: Quinn's Potion is a restorative draught concocted by Apothecary Renferrel in the Sepulcher. It is brewed to stabilize and revitalize the wounded Deathstalker Quinn Yorick following a disastrous scouting patrol in Silverpine Forest.

p: After Deathstalker Quinn Yorick was severely battered and incapacitated near the Ivar Patch, word reached the Royal Apothecary Society at the Sepulcher. Apothecary Renferrel hastily compounded this specialized draught to facilitate Quinn's recovery. While Renferrel rarely lets minor field casualties distract him from his grander, more sinister research for Lady Sylvanas, he provided the restorative to get the injured scout back on his feet and capable of travel.
